abstract: A Japanese girl is reported who had the typical clinical features of Aicardi syndrome associated with embryonal carcinoma. She developed infantile spasms at approximately 4 weeks of age; her seizures were intractable in spite of treatment with numerous antiepileptic drugs and ACTH. At 22 months of age, her left cheek gradually became swollen. Laboratory findings were normal except for a marked increase in serum alpha-fetoprotein. A transoral biopsy of the tumor revealed an embryonal carcinoma. This patient is the first reported with Aicardi syndrome and embryonal carcinoma. The relationship between congenital malformations and neoplasms is discussed.
abstract_ja: 日本人女児で、アイカルディ症候群の典型的な臨床像に胎児性癌を合併した症例を報告する。生後約4週で点頭てんかんを発症し、多数の抗てんかん薬とACTHによる治療にもかかわらず難治であった。22か月時に左頬部が徐々に腫脹した。検査所見は、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の著明な上昇を除き正常であった。経口生検により腫瘍は胎児性癌と診断された。本例はアイカルディ症候群と胎児性癌を合併した初めての症例である。先天奇形と腫瘍の関連について考察した。
